Rachin Ravindra doubtful for India series after shoulder injury

New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra is a doubt for the upcoming Twenty20 series against India after dislocating his right shoulder. The injury occurred while he was filming a diving catch during a promotional shoot in Auckland. The New Zealand cricket board confirmed the incident on Saturday. Ravindra's participation in the series, scheduled for next month, is now uncertain.
